claim_policy: Pattern records are educational examples only. They are not client results, medical outcomes, financial outcomes, or performance guarantees.

patterns.title: Founder restarting after missed days
patterns.situation: A founder has one bad day and needs the system to prevent a shame spiral from becoming a lost week.

patterns.title: Creative with too many projects
patterns.situation: A creative has too many open loops and needs arbitration before starting new work.

patterns.title: Athlete after an injury reset
patterns.situation: A competitive person needs continuity without pretending capacity is unchanged.

patterns.title: Executive in a new seat
patterns.situation: A newly promoted operator needs clearer foreground priority selection.

patterns.title: Parent rebuilding an evening routine
patterns.situation: A parent needs a low-friction system that works after childcare and exhaustion.

patterns.title: Student before final exams
patterns.situation: A student needs daily sequencing and end-of-day closure instead of panic planning.

patterns.title: Consultant in client-delivery chaos
patterns.situation: A consultant needs to separate revenue-critical work from reactive noise.

patterns.title: Operator after burnout
patterns.situation: An operator needs a Minimum Viable Day protocol before intensity returns.

patterns.title: Career-switcher certification plan
patterns.situation: A career-switcher needs a 30/60/90 execution path without self-renegotiation.

patterns.title: Solopreneur launch week
patterns.situation: A solo operator needs one foreground priority and a maintenance list.

patterns.title: Sales leader follow-up discipline
patterns.situation: A sales leader needs a daily prompt to protect relationship follow-through.

patterns.title: Researcher recovering deep work
patterns.situation: A researcher needs ambiguity stops and protected blocks after scattered weeks.

patterns.title: Startup CEO during investor week
patterns.situation: A CEO needs pressure management and sequencing under external deadlines.

patterns.title: Freelancer with scope creep
patterns.situation: A freelancer needs boundaries and an arbitration filter for competing client requests.

patterns.title: High performer on a low-mood day
patterns.situation: A high performer needs the day reduced without turning the miss into identity damage.

patterns.title: Founder during travel week
patterns.situation: A founder needs mobile continuity and a smaller daily floor.

patterns.title: Writer finishing a manuscript
patterns.situation: A writer needs the first physical action defined before perfectionism expands.

patterns.title: Manager with conflicting priorities
patterns.situation: A manager needs leverage, urgency, and downside compared before deciding.

patterns.title: Wellness reset with MVD
patterns.situation: A user needs health continuity without using wellness as a punishment loop.

patterns.title: Second-act operator rebuilding structure
patterns.situation: A person rebuilding after disruption needs the system to hold structure while confidence returns.
